description: Does this project hold the same Blender model more than once (two whole imports side by side)? Answers "N copies of <model>: … Keep one?" with each copy (its Entity, entityRef, part count) and its delete plan. It changes nothing: which copy stays is the user's choice, and the other is removed with r3_editor_delete({projectId, componentIds, confirm: {mode: "bundle", planToken}}) once they have chosen.
name: r3_blender_copies

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Find duplicate copies of a Blender model in a project
